item.title: Trump takes his "Lake America" push to Apple
item.description: President Trump has personally asked Apple to rename Lake Ontario to "Lake America" on Apple Maps, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum said in an interview.

item.title: Trump frequently targets female reporters
item.description: The president and his team often highlight his media accessibility, yet female reporters in his circle are frequently dismissed or attacked.

item.title: Two words that most worry global central bankers
item.description: The traditional separation between fiscal and monetary policy responsibilities is increasingly blurred, causing concern among central bankers worldwide.

item.title: Trump weighs limited strikes on Iran over Hormuz attacks
item.description: President Trump and senior aides are considering limited military action in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding its radar capabilities.
